cat << 'EOF' > /work/lamp_pixels.py
import cv2
import numpy as np

for f in [2, 12, 18, 20]:
    img = cv2.imread(f'/work/observations/obs_{f:04d}.png')
    # Cone is yellow: let's get bounding box of yellow cone
    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
    mask = cv2.inRange(hsv, (15, 30, 80), (35, 255, 255))
    ys, xs = np.where(mask > 0)
    print(f"Frame {f}: cone x range [{xs.min()}, {xs.max()}], y range [{ys.min()}, {ys.max()}], center_x = {np.mean(xs):.1f}")
    
    # Base disc on floor: let's find dark pixels near base
    # camera height is 1.55m, floor is y_cam > 0 (v > 255.5)
    # The disc is dark grey around y in [400, 511]
    dark_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 40) & (img[:, :, 0] < 80) & \
                (img[:, :, 1] > 40) & (img[:, :, 1] < 80) & \
                (img[:, :, 2] > 40) & (img[:, :, 2] < 80)
    # restrict to x near cone center
    x_c = int(np.mean(xs))
    sub_mask = np.zeros_like(dark_mask)
    sub_mask[:, max(0, x_c-50):min(512, x_c+50)] = dark_mask[:, max(0, x_c-50):min(512, x_c+50)]
    dys, dxs = np.where(sub_mask > 0)
    if len(dys) > 0:
        print(f"Frame {f}: base/pole x range [{dxs.min()}, {dxs.max()}], y range [{dys.min()}, {dys.max()}], center_x = {np.mean(dxs):.1f}, bottom_y = {dys.max()}")
